acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, vertically-oriented oval-shaped mark with a dark perimeter and lighter central area is visible on the mid-to-posterior lateral flank. Irregular tissue protrusions and skin texture variations are present anterior to this mark.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral-lateral surface and swimming in the immediate proximity of the pectoral and pelvic regions.
